notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mardu Warshrieker, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Mardu Warshrieker from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Mardu Warshrieker enters the battlefield, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.
